summary: Say which published agents roster the summary's agent counts came from

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The summary resource gains an optional agents_as_of object (store_index, published_at) naming the published agents roster its working-agent and machine counts came from. It is outside the revision, and kept while the counts are unchanged. The Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients model it; older clients ignore it.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.
